Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Pakistan players make their way out on the field. Followed by Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd who walk out to open for Netherlands. Naseem Shah to start with the new ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, at one stage it looked like Pakistan could reach 300 but they have not even been able to play out their 50 overs. The Netherlands have a golden opportunity to register a win and will need all their batters to perform. Pakistan will try and get purchase out of this wicket with the new ball to put the hosts under pressure. Do we have a massive upset on the cards? We will find out soon after a short break.

The hosts were right on the money from the world go. Vivian Kingma got a wicket on his first delivery but after that, they found it difficult to take wickets. Their fielding was top quality today barring a dropped catch and missed stumping opportunity by the skipper, Scott Edwards behind the wicket. Scott Edwards mixed his bowlers up well through the innings and even though a partnership was building, they managed to keep it tight. Their disciplined bowling finally got rewarded as Pakistan kept losing wickets trying to accelerate towards the end of the innings. Bas de Leede was expensive initially but came back strong to take three wickets. Aryan Dutt was outstanding once again and all the front-line bowlers had a wicket in their kitty.

Pakistan would be disappointed with their batting effort! They lost their debutant opener, Abdullah Shafique quite early on after which Babar Azam joined Fakhar Zaman to steady the innings. They put on a 55-run partnership before the latter slipped out. Pakistan were far too watchful and their strategy to play slow initially and then accelerate, seems to have backfired as the low scoring rate kept building the pressure. They were 104 for the loss of 2 wickets but a mini collapse saw them teetering at 168 for 6. Babar Azam missed out on his century yet again being dismissed on 91. Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman could not make the most of their reprieve. The lower order later failed to make much of an impact but did just enough to get them over the 200 mark.

The Dutch have bowled out their much-fancied opponents! What a complete bowling performance this has been from the Netherlands team! Despite the fact that they have lost this series, they came out to fight and have restricted Pakistan to a under-par score of 206. The pitch report indicated that this is a batting paradise but we have seen the Dutch bowlers prove that wrong. They will now look to come out and perform with the bat to seal what could be an historic win.

OUT! CAUGHT! Vivian Kingma gets another wicket in his kitty. It is full and on off. Shah swings hard at it. It flies high in the air towards long on. Logan van Beek there takes a sharp catch. Pakistan are bundled out for just 206.
Commentary.Howout: c Logan van Beek b Vivian Kingma

Commentary.Commentary: Shahnawaz Dahani is the last batter out in the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up here and Zahid Mahmood walks back to the pavilion. It is fuller, outside off. Shah shuffles across and looks to scoop it away. It goes to the left of the keeper off the cue end. Zahid Mahmood is on the charge for a run but Shah never called for it. Scott Edwards throws the ball to the bowler, Vivian Kingma walks towards the stumps and clips the bails at the non-striker's end.
Vivian Kingma fires it into the pads, Mahmood clips it to deep square leg for one.
Fuller, on the pads, Mahmood eases it back to the bowler.
Shorter, on the body. Mahmood pulls it to deep square leg and takes a single.
WIDE! It is full, outside the tramline. The umpire signals a wide. Bas de Leede has to reload his final delivery here.
SIX! He connects this time and sends it sailing over the ropes. A short ball, on off. Zahid Mahmood stands tall and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
A slower bumper, on off. Zahid Mahmood looks to pull it away but misses.
Length ball, on off, Zahid Mahmood dabs it down to third man. They look for a single but decide against it. There is an appeal for run out but the replays confirm the batters is safe.
A single now as this is pulled through mid-wicket.

Naseem Shah makes the most of the review and survives. It is full, wide outside off. Shah swings hard at it. There is some noise but it looks like he hit his bat on the ground. Scott Edwards takes the catch behind the stick and appeals. The umpire takes his time but gives it out. Shah takes the review and it confirms that there is day and light between bat and ball.
Full length, on the pads, Shah glances it to the left of the keeper for a single.

Woah! Naseem Shah is lucky to not see his blade crash into the stumps. It is a good-length ball, on off. Shah looks to heave it across the line. The blade flies off the hands once he connects, The ball goes to cover but straight to the fielder.
It is full, on middle and leg. Zahid Mahmood uses his feet and flicks it to square leg. They take one.
Full length, on the pads, Shah flicks it to square leg for one.

Vivian Kingma is right on the money this time and the umpire thinks the same. Naseem Shah though is not satisfied and takes the review for lbw. Coming to the delivery, it is tailing in, full and on leg. Shah stays back and looks to dig it out but fails to get any blade on it. He gets hit on his shoes. Kingma appeals and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. The review is taken and it confirms that the ball is missing the wickets. Naseem Shah survives and Pakistan do not lose a review here as well.
It is angled into the pads, Shah looks to flick it away but misses. It rolls out of his pads but the batters do not take a run here.
WIDE! Fuller, down leg. Shah misses his flick. Wide called.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! An off-cuter this time, full and wide outside off. Wasim shuffles across and throws his blade at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards the keeper. Scott Edwards makes no mistake behind the sticks. Bas de Leede gets his third wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Bas de Leede

Commentary.Commentary: Zahid Mahmood is the new batter out in the middle. Vivian Kingma is into the attack. He will be bowling straight after the first Powerplay. He has given 10 runs in his 4 overs and taken one wicket.
WIDE! A slower bumper, on off. Wasim stays back and looks to hook it away but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
It is full, outside off, Wasim shuffles across and looks to scoop it away. It goes to short fine leg off the top of the blade.
Length ball, on off, defended out.
Naseem Shah strides out to the middle. Pakistan need a cameo from one of their tail-enders.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammad Nawaz's cameo comes to an end. Bas de Leede strikes for the second time in this game. It is a slower ball, full and on off. Nawaz gets down on one knee and looks to slog it away. It goes high in the air off the outside edge. Logan van Beek charges in from long on and takes a sharp running catch to break this stand.
Commentary.Howout: c Logan van Beek b Bas de Leede

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on the bodyline. Wasim pulls it through square leg for one more.
Full length, on the stumps, Nawaz strokes it to cover for one.
Bas de Leede (7-0-38-1) has been brought back into the attack.
A short ball now, Nawaz stands tall and pulls it to long on. It meets the fielder on a bounce. They cross for one.
A slower ball this time, full and on the pads. Wasim nudges it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
A length ball, outside off. Wasim comes down the track and eases it to covers.
Good length, outside off. Nawaz pulls it to wide of long on for one. This one goes off the bottom half of the blade.
Full length, around off, Nawaz stays back and defends it out.
SIX! All the way! Mohammad Nawaz getting into the act here. It is an off cutter, full, on middle and leg. Nawaz stays back and smokes it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
SIX! BANG! Mohammad Wasim spoils this over for Aryan Dutt with a biggie off the final delivery. It is full, on off. Wasim gets down on one knee and slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Fuller, on off. Wasim pushes it to extra cover. The fielder does well to stop this.
Quicker and full, outside off. Wasim presses forward and pushes it gently towards covers.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
It is tossed up, around off, this one extracts some extra bounce off the deck. Nawaz looks to cut it away but misses.
Fuller one now, angled into the pads, Nawaz hangs back and eases it to mid off.
Fraction short, outside off. Nawaz hangs back and guides it towards point. They take one.
Full length, on middle and leg. Wasim flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, on the stumps. Wasim blocks it back to the bowler.
Touch fuller, on leg stump. Nawaz gets low and sweeps it to short fine leg for one more.
A length ball, on the pads, Wasim tucks it square on the leg side for one.
A length ball, outside off, Wasim taps it to point.
Logan van Beek has been given the ball. Another bowler who has performed really well conceding 20 runs in his 7 overs and taking a wicket.
It is tossed up, on middle and leg. Nawaz blocks it out watchfully.
A single now as this is eased down to third man.
Mohammad Wasim makes his way out to middle. Pakistan are in some trouble here.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A one-handed stunner from Dutt this time to get rid of the opposition skipper. Babar Azam holes out in his 90s. Netherlands players are ecstatic now and rightly so. It is tossed up, around off. Babar Azam hangs back and looks to flick it away. The ball though goes to the right of the bowler off the bottom half of the blade. Aryan Dutt dives to his right with his right-hand stretched out and the ball sticks in his palms.
Fuller and on off. Nawaz lofts it towards long on. It lands short of the fielder. They take one.
On off, defended out solidly.
It is touch short, on off. Nawaz hangs back and looks to cut it away. It takes the inside edge and goes through the gap between his legs.
Aryan Dutt has been given the ball now and he has been exceedingly economical without picking up a wicket. 25 runs from his 8 overs so far.

Full length, on the pads, Nawaz clips it towards mid-wicket. They scamper across for a quick single. Great work by Bas de Leede nonetheless, who sprints towards the ball, gathers it and throws it at the non-striker's end. He misses but it was a valiant effort.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off, on the slower side. Nawaz swings wildly but is unable to get any blade on it.
Fraction short, on off. Azam pulls it to deep square leg. There is a misfield which allows the batters to take three.
Full length, outside off, Azam drives it crisply to covers. The fielder there makes a sharp stop.
It is a length ball, outside off. Azam punches it through the off side but is unable to find the gap.
Full and on off, flicked to short mid-wicket.

What a jaffa! Tom Cooper bowls a full delivery outside off and the ball goes on straight. Mohammad Nawaz is playing for the turn and gets a faint inside edge that misses the off stump by a fraction. Close call there for Mohammad Nawaz.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole, Mohammad Nawaz blocks this straight to cover.

SIX! Mohammad Nawaz finally gets one away! Tom Cooper continues to flight this full and outside off, Mohammad Nawaz shimmies down the wicket and wacks the ball over long on for the second boundary of the over. Is this the beggining of an assualt?
Tom Cooper flights this one full and outside off, Mohammad Nawaz taps this back towards the bowler.
Tom Cooper compensates by going short but still keeping it leg side. Babar Azam clips this to deep square leg for a run.

FOUR! Babar Azam is fighting a lone battle here! Tom Cooper serves this one full and pitching outside leg, Babar Azam shuffles down the pitch and flicks the ball over deep square leg for four more runs.
End of Powerplay 2! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the innings.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Mohammad Nawaz but Pakistan will take it any way they come! Logan van Beek bowls this slightly short and outside off, Mohammad Nawaz goes for the pull and gets an inside edge to fine leg for a boundary.
Goes a fraction full and outside off. Mohammad Nawaz taps this towards cover-point.
Logan van Beek bowls a slower delivery on a good length and outside off. Mohammad Nawaz gets beaten on the outside edge by the pace.
Good length, on top of off. Nawaz defends it back to the bowler with full face of the blade.
Length ball, on off. Azam strokes it to cover for a single.

Whizzez past the off pole! It is touch short, outside off, nips in a touch off the deck. It also stays a little low. Babar Azam stays back and looks to punch it away but misses and gets beaten on the inisde edge.
A tidy over from Cooper comes to an end. It is full and on off, Nawaz blocks it out.
Loopy ball, on off, defended out.
Full and on leg. Azam gets low and sweeps it to square leg. One run taken.
This is worked through covers for another single.
Tossed up, outside off, Azam stays back and punches it to point for one more.
A single now as this is pushed through covers.
Logan van Beek bowls short once again and outside off, Babar Azam pulls this straight to mid-wicket.
Logan van Beek goes short this time and outside off, Mohammad Nawaz gets a top edge towards third that falls short and takes a run.
On a good length and outside off, Mohammad Nawaz knocks this back down the pitch.
Logan van Beek pulls his length back outside off, Mohammad Nawaz looks to defend but gets a thick edge towards point.
Logan van Beek serves this full and outside off, Babar Azam strokes this to deep cover-point for a single.
Logan van Beek bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Babar Azam blocks this back down the pitch.
Short this time and straighter in line with the stumps, Babar Azam clips this to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary! The pressure seemed to be building with all the dot balls. Aryan Dutt bowls this won wide outside off on a fuller length and Babar Azam has room to free his hands. Lofts this over the infield and the ball flies to deep cover for a boundary.
Aryan Dutt serves this full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam blocks this on the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Continues bowling full on middle and leg, Babar Azam clips this towards mid-wicket.
This is full as well and in line with the stumps. Babar Azam sweeps this to short fine leg.
Aryan Dutt bowls this full and outside off, Babar Azam goes back in his crease and knocks this towards covers.
Bas de Leede bangs this one in short and in line with the stumps. Mohammad Nawaz ducks under this one.
Fuller, on off, blocked out on the front foot back towards the bowler.
This is angled in full, into the pads from 'round the wicket. Nawaz hangs back and nudges it to the leg side.
On the pads, flicked to fine leg for one.
Bas de Leede bowls another slower full and on off, Babar Azam knocks this towards mid on.
Mohammad Nawaz is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bas de Leede strikes and Mohammad Haris just did not looked in poor touch! Bas de Leede bowls a slower delivery full and outside off, Mohammad Haris swings at this hard and gets a top edge that flies high towards mid on. Tom Cooper is well positioned under it and takes a comfortable catch. Pakistan have lost their fifth wicket and lot of work for Babar Azam to do here.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Cooper b Bas de Leede

Commentary.Commentary: A fraction short this time and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam tucks this towards square leg.
This is full once again and floated into the pads. Babar Azam flicks this to mid-wicket.
Flights this one full and pitching on leg., Mohammad Haris charges down the wicket and clips the ball to long on for a single.
Goes really full and just outside off, Mohammad Haris blocks this into the pitch.
This is touch short and spinning into the stumps, Mohammad Haris clips this towards short fine leg.
Aryan Dutt flights this one full and outside off, Mohammad Haris looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge to cover.

Drinks break! Netherlands have been really good with the ball so far. They are making the batters work hard to get runs here. Also, they have been able to take timely wickets to put some pressure on the opposition. Babar Azam though holds the key for his side in this innings. Pakistan will be hoping that he can stay out till the very end. We heard earlier that 320 should be a par score on this wicket. Can Pakistan reach that mark? Stick around to find out how things pan out.
Bowls this on a good length as well and outside off, Mohammad Haris works this past backward point for one run and will be back on strike for the next over. Babar Azam needs to get more strike here.
Bas de Leede gets the ball to nip back in from a good length. Mohammad Haris blocks this back down the pitch.
Another slower delivery bowled full and outside off, Mohammad Haris goes for the expansive drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bas de Leede goes full and just outside off, Babar Azam clips the ball towards mid-wicket.
Bas de Leede bowls an off-cutter on a good length and outside off, Babar Azam mistimes his shot towards cover.
Bas de Leede begins with a delivery served back of a length and outside off, Mohammad Haris guides this to deep backward point for a single.
Shariz Ahmad persists with the fuller length and bowls this outside off stump, Mohammad Haris gets a stride forward and taps the ball towards long on and gets off the mark with a run.
Angles this one into the pads from a fuller length. Babar Azam clips this to long on for one.
Continues bowling full and outside off, Babar Azam stays deep in his crease and plays this to the left of the bowler.
This one is tossed up full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam blocks this back towards the bowler.
Fights this one full and outside off, Babar Azam defends this towards cover.

SIX! Shariz Ahmad starts with a poor delivery and it gets the treatment! Shariz Ahmad bowls this short and outside off, Babar Azam pulls this and gets this well over the deep mid-wicket boundary for a maximum!
Short once again and pitching on leg, Babar Azam uses the crease and clips the ball to deep square leg for a single. He will keep strike.
Tom Cooper serves this a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam goes on the back foot and blocks the ball down the pitch.
Mohammad Haris is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one bites the dust here. It is full, on middle and leg. Azam tucks it through mid-wicket. Azam calls for two straightaway. Shariz Ahmad attacks the ball from the deep and throws it to the bowler at the non-striker's end. Tom Cooper gathers the ball and clips the bails off in a flash. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays confirm that Khushdil Shah is a goner. This has been a good passage of play for Netherlands.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show that Khushdil Shah is short of the crease here.
On off, blocked out.
SIX! Babar Azam taking the charge now. It is full and on off. Azam dances down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
It is full, down leg. Azam looks to sweep it but misses.
Fuller, on the pads, Azam tucks it to the leg side.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Babar Azam strokes this to long off and they take one more single.
Shariz Ahmad is short and serves this outside off, Khushdil Shah goes on the back foot and hits this towards deep cover for one.
Shariz Ahmad flights this full and outside off, Babar Azam lost this towards long on for one more run.
FOUR! Babar Azam slaps this away! Shariz Ahmad bowls this short and outside off, Babar Azam pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Shariz Ahmad pitches this on leg from a fuller length, Khushdil Shah clips this to deep square leg for a run.
Shariz Ahmad flights this one full and outside off, Babar Azam strokes this to deep cover-point for a single.
Outside off, worked to covers yet again.
On off, Shah strokes it to extra cover.
This one is angled in from off. Shah pushes it to covers.
On off, blocked out.

FIFTY FOR AZAM! An incredible knock from the skipper, just when his side needed him the most. It is full and on off. Azam works it down to long on and crosses for a single. Azam would be looking to covert it into three-digits.
It is full, outside off, Azam presses forward and defends it out.
Slower through the air, around off. Shah stays back and eases it back to the bowler. A wicket-taking over from Ahmad comes to an end.
Outside off, tapped to point.
Khushdil Shah makes his way out to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shariz Ahmad comes back into the attack and gets the breakthrough. Agha Salman tries to break the shackles but holes out instead. It is a googly, full and on off. Salman comes down the track and flicks it aerially towards mid-wicket. He fails to get the elevation on it. Logan van Beek takes a sharp catch at chest height.
Commentary.Howout: c Logan van Beek b Shariz Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: This is tossed up, around off, it grips and turns in with some bounce. Salman hangs back and defends it watchfully.
On the pads, Azam nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
Flighted and full, outside off. Azam stays back and crunches it through covers. They take two.
Shariz Ahmad (5-0-21-0) has been brought back into the attack now.
Good length, around off, defended out watchfully. A great over by Logan van Beek comes to an end. 5 runs off it.
Much fuller, angled in on off. Salman stays inside the crease and blocks it out solidly.
Length ball, outside off. Azam hangs back and punches it past point for a single.
Incredible shot! It is a full-length ball, outside off. Salman stays back and drives it past point. Vikramjit Singh does well in the deep to save a certain boundary. They take three.
Full length, on middle and leg. Azam stays back and flicks it through square leg for one.
Length ball, on off, defended out watchfully.
It is full, angled down leg. Azam flicks it through square leg for a single.
On off, blocked out.
Flatter and on off, defended back to the bowler.
On leg, Salman clips it through mid-wicket for one.

It is full and on off. Salman gets down on one knee and looks to sweep it away. He misses and gets rapped on the pads. There is a huge appeal for lbw but the umpire is unmoved. The replays show that the ball brushes his gloves before hitting him in the pads.
Full and outside off. Salman comes down the track and blocks it out.
Straying onto the pads once more from a fuller length. Agha Salman gets a easy single as he works the ball to deep sqaure leg. 9 runs conceded in this over.
Bas de Leede bowls a slower delivery and serves this full and on off, Agha Salman waits on the ball and clips it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Bas de Leede goes back to bowling full and angling into the stumps, Babar Azam clips this to deep square leg for a single.

Agha Salman wants to get a move on here! Bas de Leede bangs this one in short and outside off, Agha Salman pulls this towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder slides and saves the boundary. They take three runs though.
Bas de Leede Goes full and straight, Agha Salman works this towards mid on.

FOUR! This has been dispatched! Agha Salman charges down the wicket and catches the ball on the full and outside off. He lifts the ball over extra cover and the ball races to the deep cover fence for four runs. Much-needed boundary for Pakistan.
Goes full once more and straight. Babar Azam is down the wicket and hits this to the right of the bowler who does well to stop it.
Tom Cooper bowls this in line with the stump on a fuller length, Babar Azam tucks this towards mid-wicket.
This is full as well and on the pads. Agha Salman ficks this to deep sqaure leg for a single.
Full once again and pitching on leg, Agha Salman clips this to mid-wicket.
Goes full once again and delivers this outside off, Babar Azam taps this towards point and takes a run.
Tom Cooper begins from around the wicket and serves this full and outside off, Babar Azam guides this to short third man.
Change. Tom Cooper (2-0-4-0) is back into the attack now.
An off cutter this time, around off. Azam works it to long on and crosses for one. Just 4 runs off the over. A great start for Bas de Leede into his second spell.
Bas de Leede serves it full, wide outside off. Azam drives it towards covers. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a great stop.
Full length, outside off. Azam hits it to sweeper cover for a brace.
A single now as this is length ball is punched through cover-point.
Length ball, on off, defended out.
Bas de Leede bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Agha Salman clips this towards mid-wicket.
Change. Bas de Leede (2-0-17-0) is back into the attack now.
Aryan Dutt serves this one short and outside off. Babar Azam cuts this straight to the point fielder.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Babar Azam defends this to cover.
Aryan Dutt continues bowling short and this time pitching on leg, Agha Salman flicks this to deep square leg for a single.
Goes short once again and in line with the stumps, Agha Salman tucks this towards mid-wicket.
This is short and angling into the stumps. Agha Salman cuts this late and just about manages to keep the ball out.
Aryan Dutt flights this one full and outside off, Agha Salman sweeps this to deep backward sqaure leg for a brace.
Change. Aryan Dutt (5-0-16-0) is back into the attack now.
This is a fraction short and angling into the body, Agha Salman works this towards fine leg for one more run and will keep strike.
Logan van Beek bowls a slower delivery full and outside off, Agha Salman hits this uppishly to the left of the bowler. He does not get to it and the ball goes to mid off.
WIDE! Logan van Beek bangs this in short and going down leg, Agha Salman ducks under this but is called wide by the umpire.
Logan van Beek goes full and outside off, Babar Azam looks to work this offside but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single,
Continues bowling on a good length but strays onto the pads. Agha Salman clips this to fine leg for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off, gets the ball to bounce a bit more off the wicket. Agha Salman fends this to the off side.
Logan van Beek bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam flicks this towards mid-wicket where the fielder parries the ball towards mid on. They take a single.
Continues bowling full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam works this to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery served full and outside off, Agha Salman sweeps this to short fine leg and takes one.
Shariz Ahmad flights this one full and outside off, Agha Salman gets a stride forward and defends this to cover.
This is flighted full outside off, Agha Salman charges down the wicket, then changes his mind and blocks the ball into the pitch.
Shariz Ahmad bowls this short and outside off, Babar Azam slaps the ball to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Babar Azam is on the charge! Shariz Ahmad flights this one full and pitches on leg., Babar Azam is down the wicket in a flash and lofts this towards wide deep mid-wicket for four runs!
A length ball, around middle and leg. Salman presses forward and pushes it towards mid on.
Good-length ball, in the channel. Azam stays back and dabs it down to third man for one.
Good length, on off, defended out.
A length ball, on off. Salman shuffles across and wrists it to square leg for one.
On off, defended out.
Logan van Beek bends his back now and serves it on off. This one does not bounce as much as the batter expected. Salman hangs back and blocks it out watchfully.
A single to end the over here! It is tossed up, full and on off. Salman gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg. They take one. A tidy over from Ahman comes to an end.
It is full and on off. Salman gets on the front foot and defends it to the leg side off the inner half.
Another single now as this is pushed down to long on.
Outside off, this is punced through point for a single.
On off, Salman comes down the track and blocks it out.
Looped up, on off, defended out.
A single now as this is pushed to covers.
Length ball, on off. Salman gets it to square leg off the inner half.
On off, blocked out.
Length ball, outside off, defended out on the front foot.
Agha Salman makes his way out to the middle. Seems like he has got a promotion up the order after his half-century in the last game.

OUT! TIMBER! Logan van Beek gets the crucial breakthrough and he is pumped up. It is a length ball, on off. Zaman stays back and looks to heave it away across the line. He misses it completely. The ball goes through an uproots the off pole this time. A huge wicket for Netherlands. Can they build on this wicket?
A length ball, on off, blocked out solidly.
Full and on off, blocked out on the front foot.
This is tossed up, outside off, spinning away, Azam slashes it to covers.
Flighted and full, on middle and leg. Zaman eases it to mid on for one.
There is some issue with a patch on the field. The ground staff comes in to have a look now. The umpires have decided to take DRINKS!

Once again, Babar Azam is making the most of his good form and is building a nice partnership with Fakhar Zaman. They have crossed their fifty-run partnership and will look to continue batting the way they have. The Netherlands picked up an early wicket but since then have not been able to get a breakthrough. They have been economical though and will hope they can continue to build the pressure.
FOUR! Incredible shot. Full and outside off. Zaman frees his arms and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Fuller and on off. Zaman reverse sweeps it to backward point.
Full, on off, blocked out on the front foot.
Logan van Beek begins with a maiden over! He bowls this one full and outside off, Babar Azam works this towards point.
Make that five! Logan van Beek serves this a fraction short and outside off. Babar Azam blocks this towards the cover region.
Continues bowling on a good length and this time in line with the stumps. Babar Azam defends this to the bowler's right. Four dot balls now.
This is on a good length and outside off, Babar Azam knocks this firmly to the cover fielder.
Goes full this time and outside off, Babar Azam hits this hard straight to cover.
Logan van Beek begins with a back-of-a-length delivery just outside off, Babar Azam knocks this back to the bowler.
Shariz Ahmad continues to give the ball some air and bowls this full outside off, Babar Azam knocks this to long off and takes a single to keep strike.
Flights this one full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman taps this towards cover with soft hands and takes a quick run.
Floats this one full and outside off, Babar Azam works this to long on for a run.
Shariz Ahmad bowls this one short and outside off, Babar Azam plays this from his back foot straight to cover.
Full once again and outside off. Babar Azam strokes this straight to short cover.
Shariz Ahmad bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam flicks this to mid-wicket.
On off, blocked out.
Aryan Dutt flights this on full and just outside off, Fakhar Zaman flicks this to mid on.
Short again and outside off, Fakhar Zaman takes an easy single as he cuts this to deep point.

Missed opportunity! Scott Edwards has been really poor behind the wicket. First the drop and now a missed stumping. Aryan Dutt flights this one full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman charges down the wicket and looks to heave this. He misses and so does Scott Edwards as he does not collect the ball cleanly. Fakhar Zaman thought he was a goner but manages got back home.
Short this time and outside off, Babar Azam cuts this to deep backward point for a single.
Aryan Dutt bowls this full and outside off, Babar Azam blocks this into the pitch.
Full length, on off, Azam strokes it to sweeper cover for one.
Slower one now, full and on off. Azam gets forward and blocks it into the deck off the inner half.
This is flicked through mid-wicket for one.
This one stays low. Fuller, on off. It does not bounce much on the deck. Zaman gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Looped up, full and outside off. Zaman looks to block it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A flighted full toss, on off. Azam hits it to wide of long off for one.
Change. Shariz Ahmad comes into the attack now.

FOUR! Fakhar Zaman gets this away to the fence! These boundaries have been far too few. Aryan Dutt fires this one full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman charges down the wicket and slaps the ball to long on past the mid on fielder for four runs.
Aryan Dutt goes back to bowling short and outside off, Babar Azam cuts this to deep point.
Beaten! Aryan Dutt bowls an arm ball pitching outside off, Babar Azam plays for the turn and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floats this one full and on middle, Babar Azam flicks this to mid-wicket.
This is straighter to the stumps and on a fuller length, Fakhar Zaman clips this to square leg for a single,.
Aryan Dutt begins with a short delivery and outside off. Babar Azam cuts this to deep point and takes a run.
Tom Cooper bowls a loopy delivery on middle, Babar Azam knocks this to long on and takes one. Just a single from this over!
Tom Cooper flights this one outside off, Babar Azam gets a stride forward and defends this to covers.
Angles this one down leg on a fuller length. Babar Azam looks to clip this down leg and gets the faintest of edges. Scott Edwards does not hold onto the ball and this is a dropped chance!
This one is short and outside off, Babar Azam cuts this straight to point.
Tom Cooper flights this one full and on the pads, Babar Azam tucks this to short fine leg.
Tom Cooper bowls this from 'round the wicket, short and on leg. Babar Azam clips this towards square leg.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the 40th over.
On off, blocked out solidly.
Fraction short, outside off. Zaman cuts it hard to backward point.
Fuller, on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
It is full and on off. Zaman comes down the track and works it to the left off the bowler off the inner half.
Fuller, on off, blocked out solidly.
Full, on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Aryan Dutt comes back into the attack. He has conceded 8 runs in his two overs so far.
A full toss this time, on off. Azam crunches it to covers but finds the fielder instead.
Azam works this short ball to square leg. The batters take two comfortably.
A single now as this is pushed down to long off.
BEATEN! Some turn on offer this time. This is angled in, outside, it turns away a touch. Zaman looks to defend it on the front foot but misses.
On off, blocked out.
Cooper starts from 'round the wicket for the left-hander. This one comes in with the arm, full and on off. Zaman defends it out.
Tom Cooper has been brought into the attack as Bas de Leede failed to keep it tight.
This is a good-length delivery, coming in from off. Azam hangs back and defends it out watchfully. A good recovery from Kingma after being hit for a boundary.
A shorter one this time, outside off. Azam hangs back and cuts it hard into the ground. The fielder at point makes a half-stop and restricts a run here.
Good length, outside off. Azam chops it to backward point.
Length ball, on off, defended out.
FOUR! Lovely drive from Azam. A full-length ball, on off. Azam gets on the front foot and creams it through mid on. It races away. No chance for the fielder to stop that one.
A length ball, outside off. Zaman pushes it gently towards mid off and scamper across for a quick single.
Good length, outside off. Azam shoulders his arms at it. An expensive over from Bas de Leede, 10 runs off it.
This is full and on off. Azam blocks it out watchfully.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off, shaping away. Azam looks to chase it but gets beaten.

FOUR! This one is straying on the pads yet again. Azam hangs back and clips it to deep square leg. Aryan Dutt in the deep, sprints to his left and puts in a dive to that side. He is able to pull the ball back in play but does so with his leg in contact with the ropes. It is a boundary in the end.
WIDE! Full-length ball, drifting down leg. Azam looks to clip it away but misses. Wided.
Short ball, on off. Zaman pulls it down to deep square leg and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Incredible shot! Full length, outside off. Fakhar Zaman slams it down the ground. It races away past mid off for a boundary.

Brilliant stop from Max O'Dowd to save a run here. It is full, outside off. Azam leans forward and drives it to the right of mid off. Max O'Dowd dives to that side and make an exceptional stop. A maiden for Vivian Kingma now.
Make that 5! A length ball, angled into the pads, Azam stays back and clips it to square leg.
Four dots in a row! This is an inswinger, full and on off. Azam blocks it out on his front foot.
Kingma serves it on a length, on top of off. Azam stands tall and defends it out off the full face.
Good length, outside off. Azam stays back and dabs it towards backward point. Not in the gap though.
A length ball, on off. Azam pushes it to extra covers.
Bas de Leede bowls a slower delivery back of a length and outside off, Fakhar Zaman looks to slash at this but the ball passes under his bat and goes through to the keeper.
Bas de Leede bowls short once again and outside off, Babar Azam slashes this into the ground and gets the ball to bounce over backward point for a single to wide third man.

FOUR! The new bat has instantly worked for Babar Azam! To be fair it was a poor delivery! Bas de Leede bangs this in short and wide outside off, Babar Azam rocks back instantly and it sits up nicely for him. He pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for his first boundary.
Babar Azam isn't happy with his blade here. There is a fresh bat making its way on the field for him. Not a long delay here.
Bas de Leede serves this full and angling in from outside off, Babar Azam defends this towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! This one is straying down leg side on and really full. Babar Azam looks to clip this fine but misses. The umpire calls this wide.
Goes fuller this time on middle and off, Fakhar Zaman blocks this wide of mid on and they take a quick single.
Bas de Leede begins with a delivery that is a fraction short and angled into the left-handed batter from 'round the wicket. Bas de Leede tucks this towards mid-wicket.
An early change in bowling. Bas de Leede comes into the attack now. He replaces Aryan Dutt.
This is quite wide outside off on a good length. Babar Azam does not bother with this as it goes through to the keeper. 4 runs of the over.
Vivian Kingma serves this one a fraction full and gets the ball to nip back into the stumps. Babar Azam blocks this out towards mid on.
Goes back of a length this time and outside off stump. Babar Azam stands tall and knocks this straight to cover.
Vivian Kingma goes full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam has his head steady over this as he clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Continues bowling on a good length but this one strays on the pads. Fakhar Zaman misses out as he clips it towards square leg for a single.
Vivian Kingma begins with a good-length delivery outside off, Babar Azam taps this towards backward point and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Bowls a loopy delivery full and wide outside off, Fakhar Zaman strokes this to the cover fielder.
This is full as well on middle and leg, Fakhar Zaman defends this to the left of the bowler.
FOUR! First boundary for Pakistan! Aryan Dutt angles this one into the pads from a fuller length, Fakhar Zaman guides the ball down to fine leg for four runs. That should release some pressure.
Flights this one full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman blocks this towards cover.
Bowls this one a fraction short and just outside off, Fakhar Zaman goes on his back foot and taps it back to the bowler.
Aryan Dutt bowls this full and spinning in from outside off, Babar Azam clips this to deep square leg and takes a single.
Continues bowling on a good length, this one wider outside off. Fakhar Zaman happy to let this go through to the keeper. A successful over from Vivian Kingma comes to an end.

A huge appeal for lbw but turned down! Vivian Kingma bowls this one a good length and pitching on leg. The ball is moving away as Fakhar Zaman tries to defend. Gets a massive inside edge onto his pads. Vivian Kingma is convinced that this is out but the umpire disagrees. Scott Edwards decides not to review.
Serves this one on a good length as well, and angling away from the off stump, Fakhar Zaman leaves this one alone.
This one is on a good length and angling in from outside off, Babar Azam clips this to deep square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Vivian Kingma bowls this one full as well and outside off, Babar Azam knocks this towards point off the outer half as the ball moves away a touch. The fielder stops the ball diving to his right.
Babar Azam walks in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Vivian Kingma strikes on his first delivery! The debutant departs after a really short stay! Vivian Kingma serves this full and just outside off, gets the ball to nip back in sharply. Abdullah Shafique tries to block along the wrong line and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball goes onto shatter the stumps. The Netherlands have drawn first blood and they look thrilled!
It will be Vivian Kingma to steam in from the other end with the second new ball.
Goes 'round the wicket now and bowls this a touch short and on the pads, Abdullah Shafique tucks this towards deep backward square leg for a single. A tidy for by Dutt to start with.
Goes full once again and flights this outside off, Abdullah Shafique gets forward and defends towards covers.
Continues bowling full and on off, Abdullah Shafique clips this to mid-wicket.
Flights this one full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman strokes this to long off and gets off the mark with a run as well.
Bowls this short and outside off, Fakhar Zaman rocks back and hits the ball straight to cover-point.
Aryan Dutt begins with a full delivery just outside off, Abdullah Shafique knocks the ball to long on and gets off the mark with a single.

The game is set to begin. The Netherlands fielders stride out to the middle. Followed by Fakhar Zaman and Abdullah Shafique who walk out to open for Pakistan. It will be Aryan Dutt to start with the new ball.

PITCH REPORT - Pierce Fletcher is there in the middle for the pitch report. He says bit of  cloud cover but it shouldn't be a problem and it’s a beautiful 22 degree day. Mentions there was some grass on top of the pitch but there has been 12 hours of rolling and the pitch is rock hard. Claims that it is a 320 run pitch. Ends by saying its the best strip we have seen over the course of this series.

Scott Edwards, the captain of Netherlands says that he isn't much disappointed about losing the toss. Mentions that the Ahmad brothers are in. Adds they just spoke a little bit about the wicket and how to execute their plans.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, is in for a chat. He says he will bat first and says there are 4 changes in the team.A  lot of opportunity for youngsters to show class. Mentions that he loves the country and the team in making sure to explore different cities as well.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Scott Edwards (C/WK), Logan van Beek, Tom Cooper, Teja Nidamanuru, Vikramjit Singh, Bas de Leede, Max O'Dowd, Musa Ahmad (In for Tim Pringle), Shariz Ahmad (In for Wesley Barresi), Aryan Dutt, Vivian Kingma.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Abdullah Shafique (In for Imam-ul-Haq), Babar Azam (C), Agha Salman, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Haris (WK) (In for Mohammad Rizwan), Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim, Naseem Shah, Shahnawaz Dahani (In for Haris Rauf), Zahid Mahmood (In for Shadab Khan).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Pakistan. They have opted to BAT first.

The hosts showed a fight in the first game but could not follow up that performance as they received quite a drubbing the second time around. They will be looking to go all guns blazing this time around as they have nothing much to lose here. Pakistan, on the flip side, look solid across all three facets and the hosts would need a complete team performance to gain something out of this final encounter. Can the visitors complete the clean sweep? Or will the hosts upset the odds? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
